description: Unique test session identifier
Participant foreign key linking to participants table
Type of cognitive task (arithmetic, comprehension, etc.)
Total correct answers in session
Total questions presented
Per-question answer array: correct, category, selected, timedOut, timeTaken (int seconds), difficulty, questionId, questionText
scientific_interpretation: Must be expanded to one row per question/trial for trial-level analysis

description: Session start timestamp (server-side)
Session completion timestamp (server-side)
Total test duration in seconds
Time taken to answer this question (integer seconds — LOW resolution)
scientific_interpretation: LIMITATION: 1-second granularity. Cannot derive precise stimulus onset. Not a true RT measure.

description: Index of correct answer (0-based)
Index selected by participant (0-based)
Question difficulty level
EMOTIV device clock timestamp for each EEG sample
Rolling sample counter, resets to 0 after 255
EMOTIV firmware interpolation flag — 1 indicates sample was reconstructed
scientific_interpretation: Interpolated samples should be excluded from artifact-sensitive analyses

description: Raw EEG voltage for 14 electrodes (AF3, F7, F3, FC5, T7, P7, O1, O2, P8, T8, FC6, F4, F8, AF4)
scientific_interpretation: Primary EEG signal. Hardware-filtered 0.16–43 Hz. Reference: CMS/DRL.

description: Electrode contact quality. 0=no contact, 4=excellent. Overall is 0–100.
scientific_interpretation: Quality control gate. Channels with CQ<2 should be flagged.

description: EMOTIV proprietary band-power estimates at 8 Hz. Algorithm undisclosed.
scientific_interpretation: CAUTION: Not validated psychological constructs. Use raw EEG for scientific analysis.

description: In-stream event markers at sample level. Populated when experimenter inserts a marker.
scientific_interpretation: Potential synchronization anchor if markers correspond to web test events

unit: Unix epoch seconds (same clock as EEG)
description: Absolute Unix timestamp of each inserted marker
scientific_interpretation: Key synchronization anchor. Must be matched to web session timestamps.

description: Marker label as entered by experimenter (e.g., Eyes_Opened, Eyes_Closed)
Participant unique identifier (links to activity_results.participant_id)
Participant full name (PII — must be anonymized)
Age at registration
Self-reported gender
Whether participant gave informed consent
Total time spent on platform across all sessions
